result.summary: Adds unit test assertions in `validation_chainstatemanager_tests.cpp` to improve mutation test coverage for assumeutxo and block pruning. Specifically, it exercises `Chainstate::GetPruneRange` on an unvalidated snapshot chainstate and calls `ChainstateManager::ActivateBestChains` immediately after snapshot validation.
result.problem: Gaps in unit test coverage allowed three synthetic mutation bugs in `validation.cpp` to survive undetected: an invalid logical operator in `ActivateBestChains` chainstate filtering, and off-by-one or inverted offset calculations in `GetPruneRange` boundary heights.
evidence: PR description and commit messages cite surviving mutation tests from MutantHub: mutant 4388 (ActivateBestChains logical operator), mutant 4385 (prune start calculation), and mutant 4386 (max prune MIN_BLOCKS_TO_KEEP offset)
result.changed_since_previous: No functional changes to the patch; full diff and commit metadata are now provided.
result.card: Adds unit test assertions in validation_chainstatemanager_tests.cpp to cover boundary edge cases in assumeutxo snapshot validation and block pruning. Without these checks, potential regressions in Chainstate::GetPruneRange offsets and ChainstateManager::ActivateBestChains chainstate filtering can pass tests undetected. The author cites three surviving mutations on MutantHub (mutants 4385, 4386, and 4388) as evidence of the test coverage gap.

risk.why: Touches only unit test assertions in validation_chainstatemanager_tests.cpp without altering production code.
